title: Cloud dev loop: an agent codes and commits in the cloud, and per-branch compute (e.g. AWS) tests and deploys the app, with no Mac in the loop
why: TJ, after parking the standalone phone: 'having coding compute spun up, committing to a repo, with the ability to have compute spun up to do testing of applications, deploy them, etc say in AWS sounds quite interesting.'

user_said: im actually quite intrigued by this. my laptop is doing a lot of heavy processing work. id like to model remote dev work and how much it would cost. maybe we start there? Im just worried about moving to remote compute that costs go through the roof

text: Write the remote dev cost model (docs/remote-dev-cost.md) once the CPU sampler finishes ~06:11 EST: game test queue, budgets refresh and ingestion, priced per CPU-hour, rented box, spot, and buying a Mac
